referenceSources.description:
This silver Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Makinen Edition is a right-hand drive, manual transmission rally car with just 26,300 kilometers on the clock. It features white multi-spoke wheels, red brake calipers, a large rear wing, and Ralliart branding on the front bumper and side skirts. The hood scoop and aggressive body kit highlight its performance heritage.

Located in North Ferriby, United Kingdom, this example is offered for £85,000. Its low mileage and special edition status make it a sought-after collector’s car for enthusiasts of the iconic Evolution series.
